notes: The app now fits every phone screen — the top is no longer cut off by the notch or status bar.
Removed the "Open in Chrome to install" banner that appeared on the top.
Update prompts now appear once per new version with the full list of changes, and stop nagging once you dismiss them.
In-app updates: see a notice when a newer Marginalia is available and install it right from the app.
Only one floating pen — the quick-capture window follows the pen wherever you drag it.
Cleaner, roomier interface with Font Awesome icons instead of emojis.
More reliable syncing with clearer error messages.
